show.description: Aaryan, a mysterious stranger, saves Mehar from a brutal attack, drawing her into a dangerous web of secrets, betrayal, and buried truths. As Mehar’s bond with Aaryan deepens, shadows of her past — a broken engagement with Rohan, a haunting criminal case, and her sister Pia’s deadly envy — begin to resurface. But is Aaryan truly here to help… or hiding something darker?
